author: marc.dubois@sdworx.com
title: SD Worx Legal Bulletin: first day of illness without medical certificate
body:
Dear Sophie, dear Laura,

As your SD Worx payroll consultant, I'm sending you a summary of our latest legal bulletin, as it affects your work regulations.

What changes
Since 28 November 2022, employees no longer need to submit a medical certificate for the first day of incapacity for work, up to 3 times per calendar year. This applies to one-day absences.

Exception for smaller employers
Employers with fewer than 50 employees can keep requiring a medical certificate for every absence, but only by stating this explicitly in their work regulations.

What this means for Lumivia
Lumivia has 46 employees, so you have a choice. Your current Article 7.3 requires a certificate for every absence. You need to decide whether to:
(a) adopt the exemption and update Article 7.3, or
(b) opt out and keep the certificate requirement, which also requires a formal amendment to confirm it.

I recommend deciding before the end of Q1 2023. I can draft the amendment for you.

Kind regards,
Marc Dubois
Payroll Consultant, SD Worx
